## About


Hello, I'm Martín Suárez Álvarez! I was born in Galicia and I am currently based in Stockholm. I'm a Biochemist (University of Barcelona) and did a MSc in Bioinformatics for Health Sciences (University Pompeu Fabra / University of Barcelona). I'm currently pursuing a PhD in immunology at (Karolinska Institutet)[https://ki.se].

I have great interest in single-cell and spatial data analysis, and mucosal immunology. Broadly, I would like to learn more about ML/DL, spatial statistics (beyond biology), and science policy.  

## Education / experience

- **2026-current:** PhD in immunology, Karolinska Institutet
- **Aug2025-Jan2026**: Research assistant, Karolinska institutet
- **2023-2025:** MSc in Bioinformatics for health sciences, University Pompeu Fabra / University of Barcelona
- **2019-2023:** BSc in Biochemistry, University of Barcelona
